dev.name: Dev (The Postman)
dev.personality: Nervous, earnest, clutching his mail satchel against the sea breeze
dev.lore: Third-generation postman in Morjim Port. Has memorized every address in the district but cannot recall delivery routes dated in the future.

mira.name: Mira (The Archivist)
mira.personality: Quiet, sharp, speaks in riddles about ocean tides and forgotten days
mira.lore: Former maritime clerk who took custody of the coastal vault after the Great Fog of 1982. Guards drawer 7 with a brass latch.

listener.name: The Listener
listener.personality: Enigmatic, omniscient, echoes through the stone walls
listener.lore: An omnipresent acoustic echo circulating through the salt-encrusted speaking pipes beneath the cliffside road.
